thread:
sarah (AE): Heads-up — Prospect 'Sentinel Health' submitted a SIG/CAIQ v3 during our pricing POC. They want a completed questionnaire + SOC2 evidence before next Wed. Filed the doc here: https://files.redwood/sentinel/sig-v3.pdf

security-bot: New intake created: SR-7890. Assigned to security queue.

jordan (sales-ops): tagging security — can someone pick this up? POC start scheduled next Mon, we need answers to ~40 control items and a short summary for the customer.

maya (security): I can take primary on this. Quick Q: will the POC include customer data or only synthetic/test inputs? That changes our BYOK/ingress guidance.

sarah (AE): Only synthetic for POC, but customer asked if we support BYOK and VPC options for later stage. Also they'd like to see encryption-at-rest details and key rotation cadence.

maya (security): OK. For the SIG we'll mark 'BYOK available via Private deployment + KMS' and reference our docs. Need confirmation on KMS provider options (GCP/KMS vs AWS KMS vs HSM). Sam, can you confirm supported KMS providers for Private?

sam (solutions): We support AWS KMS and GCP KMS out of the box for Private; HSM pluggable via partner integrations (requires ent. support). For Dedicated/Hosted we have envelope encryption and can rotate keys quarterly. I'll paste config snippet they can use in POC: 
```yaml
private:
  kms_provider: aws
  kms_key_id: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-ef01
  rotation: quarterly
```

liz (legal): FYI — customer wants an NDA before we share SOC2. Sales already has standard NDA?

sarah (AE): I sent our standard mutual NDA yesterday, awaiting signature. If they sign today we can pull SOC2 redacted report into the thread.

maya (security): I'll start filling high-risk items first (network segmentation, key management, data retention). Plan: 1) draft SIG answers, 2) attach SOC2 pointer + evidence notes, 3) call out any compensating controls. ETA EOD tomorrow.

jordan (sales-ops): Perfect. Please flag anything that would block the POC (e.g., requirement for customer-managed HSM during POC) — we may need to adjust timeline.

maya (security): Noted. So far nothing blocking for synthetic-only POC. If they request BYOK for POC we'd need extra setup (ent ops) and +2 weeks.

sarah (AE): I'll update the customer on BYOK lead time and push for NDA signature today.

security-bot: SR-7890 status updated -> "assigned: maya (security)"

maya (security): Uploading preliminary SIG draft to the intake folder: https://files.redwood/sentinel/sig-draft-v1.docx — comments welcome.

sam (solutions): Minor note: mention that Dedicated supports pinned model versions and predictable throughput — they asked about stability under burst. Helps with control items about availability.

maya (security): Good call, will include availability SLA blurb.

liz (legal): If NDA signs today, I can approve redacted SOC2 share. Keep me looped.

sarah (AE): Customer signed NDA — sending SOC2 link now. Thanks everyone.

security-bot: SR-7890 evidence uploaded -> redwood-soc2-redacted.pdf

maya (security): Draft complete and uploaded. Two action items for sales: 1) confirm POC uses synthetic data only, 2) confirm they understand BYOK timeline (+2 weeks). Once confirmed I'll mark SR-7890 as "ready for customer".

sarah (AE): Confirmed with customer on both. They accept BYOK schedule if needed. Please move to ready.

maya (security): Marking SR-7890 -> ready for customer. Closing notes: no high-severity gaps for POC; recommended to follow Private deployment for production with KMS.

jordan (sales-ops): Thanks — updating CRM and recording intake complete.

sarah (AE): Awesome — we'll present this during the POC kickoff. :tada:
